payout_quote: Union County NJ (Sept 22, 2026): poll workers earn $300 for Election Day (Nov 3, 2026 general); the workday begins at 5:15 a.m. and continues until at least 8:15 p.m. Mandatory training for new workers.
steps: Apply at ucnj.org/pollworker (Union County, age 16+; 18+ must be registered voters)
Work Election Day 5:15 a.m.–at least 8:15 p.m.
Receive $300 for the day (state statute rate)
catches: Pay is reduced to minimum wage for required training not attended — training compliance affects pay.
biggest_catch: $300 for a 15-hour day — about $20/hour, among the best Election Day rates found.
eligibility: Union County residents 16+ (18+ must be registered to vote).
timing: Paid for the election; $300/day per NJ statute (A-208, 2022).
